name: D.P.S. SG set3
source:
D.P.S. SG Set 3 is the fourth entry in the D.P.S./Dream Program System series. Like the other D.P.S. games, it is a collection of three short scenarios, which are unrelated to each other story-wise and can be played separately. Those scenarios are presented as cartridges played on a fictional console named Dream Program System. Each scenario allows the player to choose between two different protagonists, or two different personalities for the protagonist. All of the scenarios feature nudity and/or sexual situations.

The scenarios in this game include:

1. A rather mundane depiction of a young couple's day directly after their wedding. The two return home and prepare for the "big event" in the night. The player can choose to control either the husband or the wife.

2. A story entitled Graduation, which begins with a rather standard premise of a shy high school boy trying to express his love to a pretty school mate. However, the events take an unexpected turn when a dragon appears and the girl is hurt. The player can determine the personality of the hero before the start of the episode.

3. A bizarre fantasy tale with the title Rabbit P4P. The protagonist follows a mysterious "bunny girl" into a fairy tale-like realm, where he has to figure out what to do in order to win the graces of magical creatures, which look like young and pretty women. The personality choice influences the hero's attitude in this episode as well.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/dps-sg-set-3]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《D.P.S. SG set3》是《D.P.S.／夢幻程式系統》系列第四作。與其他《D.P.S.》作品一樣，本作由三段彼此毫無關聯、可以單獨遊玩的短篇劇情組成，並將它們包裝成虛構主機「夢幻程式系統」上的遊戲卡帶。每段劇情都可以從兩位主角中選一位，或為同一主角選擇兩種不同性格。所有劇情均含有裸體、性愛情境，或兩者兼有。

本作收錄以下劇情：

1. 一段頗為平淡的新婚日常，描寫年輕夫妻婚禮結束後的那一天。兩人回到家中，為夜裡的「重頭戲」作準備。玩家可以扮演丈夫或妻子。

2. 《畢業》以一個常見的情節開場：害羞的高中男生試圖向漂亮女同學告白。然而，一條龍突然現身，女孩也因此受傷，故事就此朝意想不到的方向發展。玩家可在劇情開始前決定男主角的性格。

3. 《兔女郎P4P》是一篇怪誕的奇幻故事。主角跟隨神秘「兔女郎」進入童話般的世界，必須設法贏得一群外表如年輕美女般的魔法生物青睞。性格選擇同樣會影響男主角在本篇中的態度。
